question: Which Indian state has the lowest population density as per the Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **As per the Census 2011, Arunachal Pradesh has the lowest population density among all the Indian states.**
 
• The population density of Arunachal Pradesh is** 17 people per square kilometer.**
 
• Sikkim, Nagaland, and Mizoram have population densities of 86, 119, and 52 people per square kilometer respectively.
 
• ** Arunachal Pradesh is located in the northeastern part of India and shares its borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar.**
 
• The state is known for its diverse tribal culture, scenic beauty, and rich biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Sikkim is the least populous state in India **with a population of around 6.6 lakh as per the **Census 2011.** It is known for its natural beauty, Buddhist culture, and adventure tourism.
 
• Nagaland is a state located in the northeastern part of India and is known for its rich tribal culture and scenic beauty. It has a population of around 20 lakh as per the Census 2011.
 
• Mizoram is a state located in the northeastern part of India and is known for its natural beauty, rich tribal culture, and unique cuisine. It has a population of around 10 lakh as per the Census 2011.
